draft.shortGloss: to break; to tear; to break up

notes: Has an irregular past participle: 'roto' (e.g., 'He roto el vaso' — I have broken the glass).

senses.definition: To damage something hard so that it separates into pieces or stops working.

examples.text: He roto un vaso de cristal sin querer.

senses.definition: To pull paper or fabric apart into pieces, or to damage it by pulling.

examples.text: No rompas esta carta, es muy importante.
examples.translation: Don't tear up this letter, it's very important.

senses.definition: To end a romantic relationship or friendship (often used with 'con').

examples.text: Marta ha roto con su novio.
examples.translation: Marta has broken up with her boyfriend.
